coaches.bio: Paralympic fencer who competed in Beijing and Barcelona. National coach for wheelchair fencing and in charge of the children's group.
coaches.photoAlt: Carlos Soler, president and adapted fencing coach of Club de Esgrima Torremolinos

coaches.bio: Has been fencing for {1} years, with several international appearances. Has coached sabre at an international training camp in China. An active competitor and coach of the teenagers-and-adults group.
coaches.photoAlt: Víctor Santiago, technical director and fencing coach of Club de Esgrima Torremolinos, wearing a mask and holding a sabre in the club room
